Author: Jed
Name: Sae's Undercutter
Description:
Sae's Undercutter keeps an eye on your retainers' market board listings and helps you react fast when someone undercuts you -- without digging through Universalis or clicking through menus by hand.

UNDERCUT CHECKING
Open a retainer's sell list and click Check All to compare every listed item against the lowest price elsewhere. Undercut items are flagged immediately, with a one-click Adjust to Undercut that opens the price dialog, compares live prices, and fills in a new competitive price for you to confirm.

FORCE CHECK
Runs through every stale listing on a retainer automatically, pausing at each item that needs your approval. Identical listings already at a competitive price are skipped. You control how stale is too stale, and how long to wait between items.

ALL RETAINERS
From the summoning bell's retainer list, Force Check All Listings visits every retainer with listings in order, opens its sell list, runs Force Check, and moves on to the next. Each retainer also has its own Force Check Listings and Collect Gil buttons.

UNDERCUT TARGET
Choose per retainer whether to undercut just your server or your whole data centre. Data centre prices for other worlds come from Universalis, and the listings window shows which world each one is on.

PRICE WINDOWS
While adjusting a price, see a big OLD PRICE -> NEW PRICE readout and every competing listing with HQ ones marked, with adjustable text size.

Commands: /saeuc to toggle the check window, /saeuc config to open settings.
Punchline: Catches undercut retainer listings and walks you through repricing them, one retainer or all of them.
